# Ferrow: a guide for AI agents

> Ferrow puts planned maintenance, inspections and contractor work into one schedule.

This page is for AI agents and assistants reading https://www.example.com/. It says where the site's content is in plain text and how to cite it.

## Where things are

- Every page, with a one-line description: https://www.example.com/llms.txt
- The whole site in one file: https://www.example.com/llms-full.txt
- The markdown version of a page is at its address with `.md` in place of the last slash: https://www.example.com/about/ has https://www.example.com/about.md, and the home page has https://www.example.com/index.md. Each page also names its own in `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`.
- Every address, for crawlers: https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml
- Ferrow blog (feed): https://www.example.com/blog/rss.xml
- What crawlers may visit: https://www.example.com/robots.txt

## How to cite this site

Name the page and Ferrow, and link to the page's own address (the `canonical` line at the top of each markdown version), not to the markdown copy. Quote the words as they are; dates and figures are as stated on the page.

## Contact

- Email: hello@example.com
- Contact page: https://www.example.com/contact/

## About this file

It is written from the site's published pages each time the site is built. It holds no scripts and changes only when the site does.
